fullContentHtml:
Rajasthan Safai Karamchari Online Form 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : Rajasthan Local Self Government Department has released a notification for the recruitment of Safai Karamchari (Sweeper) posts on its official Website. This recruitment has been announced for a total of 24,752 posts. The online application process for Rajasthan Safai Karamchari Recruitment 2026 will start from 15 August 2026, and candidates can apply until 28 September 2026. Candidates are advised to check the complete details for Rajasthan Safai Karamchari Recruitment 2026 given below.

Important Dates

  • Notification Date : 27 July 2026
  • Application Start : 15 August 2026
  • Last Date for Apply: 28 September 2026
  • Last Date Fee Payment : 28 September 2026
  • Admit Card : Notify Later

Application Fee

  • General / Other State : Rs. 600/-
  • OBC / BC / SC / ST  : Rs. 400/-
  • Correction Charge : Rs. 100/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Cash at Rajasthan E Mitra Portal or Through Debit Card, Credit Card, Net Banking.

How to Apply Online

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the online application / registration link.
  3. Register with your basic details like name, email, mobile number.
  4. Fill the application form with personal, educational and address details.
  5. Upload scanned photograph, signature and required documents.
  6. Pay the application fee online.
  7. Submit the form and take a printout for future reference.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

What is Rajasthan Safai Karamchari Online Form 2026?

Rajasthan Safai Karamchari Online Form 2026 is a government exam related notification. Complete details including important dates, fee, eligibility and links are provided above.

What is the last date to apply?

The last date to apply is 28 September 2026.

Where can I find the official website?

The official website is: https://jankalyanfile.rajasthan.gov.in/WebMyWayFiles/OrderEntry/LSG/2026/Recruitment_Related/O_270726_b3f2c06b-6021-49a2-9661-14cdb0f93dd0.pdf
